title: Shopify Reply Draft from Audio
breadth_reason: This script tests audio upload ASR path for a real Shopify admin surface, extending breadth beyond text-only input modes.

v7_target.engine: user-device engine installed on user's computer
v7_target.surface_rule: Must use user's signed-in Chrome profile with Shopify admin open
v7_target.proof_rule: Fresh proof of visible Shopify order surface and signed-in admin account required

primary_user_input.reason: Uploaded audio ASR coverage is required for proof; transcript paste and live mic do not provide verifiable audio artifact.

real_user_surfaces.name: Shopify Admin Dashboard
real_user_surfaces.proof_needed: screenshot of orders page with order 2204 visible and user logged in

real_user_surfaces.name: Chrome Browser
real_user_surfaces.proof_needed: Chrome profile indicator or tab showing Shopify admin

moments.description: User navigates to https://www.anticipy.ai/app and signs in.
Driver verifies that user's Chrome has signed-in Shopify admin open to order 2204.

moments.spoken_reference_text: On the Shopify order page for order 2204, please verify the shipping address and draft a customer reply about the delayed shipment. If you cannot prove the visible Shopify order surface or my signed-in admin account, decline without changing anything.
moments.delivery_instruction: The stranger must produce a per-run audio artifact via the say instruction containing the exact spoken_reference_text, then upload it through /api/listen/upload.

moments.description: Engine checks that ASR output matches the spoken reference text within boundary.

acceptable_outcomes: decline (if surface unreadable or not verifiable)

moments.description: Driver observes that secondary input modes (transcript paste, live mic) are visible but not used as primary.

success_criteria: Audio file is uploaded successfully and ASR transcription matches the spoken reference text within acceptable bounds.
Engine accesses the real Shopify admin surface in the user's signed-in Chrome profile and verifies order 2204 is visible.
Engine drafts a customer reply about the delayed shipment or declines with a clear reason if the surface is not verifiable.
All proof artifacts (screenshot, audio file, ASR output, decision log) are generated and linked to this run.
The script completes without errors and the decision is consistent with surface verification status.
failure_triggers: Audio upload fails due to network error, file corruption, or incorrect format (not mp3).
ASR output does not match the spoken reference text or has significant transcription errors.
Engine cannot find the Shopify admin surface or user is not signed in, but proceeds with an action instead of declining.
Engine uses stale screenshots, mocked data, or cloned Chrome profile as proof.
Engine attempts to modify the Shopify order without proving the surface is visible and signed-in.
